mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the drainage network to the supplied arm was most worthwhile: it brought the separate constructions together and showed why the return route matters alongside blood supply.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the duct to the venous junction felt like a predictable fitting step. It made the route complete, but added little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: I found it useful that proteins travel with fluid into the lymphatic capillaries, and that the fluid is called lymph once inside.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the item pictures and route toward the neck vein gave each connection a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how another body system connects to this model. The comparison between inadequate return and a roughly steady fluid level made the construction's effect interesting.
